title: AgenticOperatingPatterns
description: Clustered KEEP/BAN operating patterns distilled into Swarm Delivery Law (ADR-0711 Amendment C / operating-patterns catalog). Not paraphrases of the source archive.

_meta.corpus: ADR-0711 Amendment C operating-patterns catalog (archive distillation 000-136)

keep.rule: Design cleanup/ownership of replicated state before scaling parallelism; size by replicated mass, not lane count.
Dense observation does not grant intervene/APPROVE/own rights; automation stops at authority edge.
Verified-empty, honest undecided, and precise halt are completed ops — record them; do not invent work to fill silence.
HEAD-keyed receipts; multi-signal done (CI + review + mergeState + live surface); new HEAD → new evidence; quarantine invalid receipts.
Missing inputs/identity → fail closed; blockers named by gate with next action; silence only when proven idle.
Batch same-subsystem work into one lane; planner ≠ implementer; one implementer + adversarial reviewers; accelerate on owner-hook, brake on verified empty.
On index.lock / shared-object contention: check owning pid, retry idempotent — never blind-delete the lock.
Green admits the next gate only, not departure; same-author APPROVE banned; re-verify at moment of action.
Public/live smoke after deploy; build ≠ publish; wrapper noise ≠ artifact fail; post-merge until live surface is green.
Sharp labels as action switches; forever names follow specs/naming-taxonomy.json.

ban.rule: Inventing work into verified empty; activity theater; filler quotas; observing = intervening.
Dual-home / dual-truth; carrying yesterday’s green as today’s proof; sticky prior merge-admission green across new HEAD.
Cargo/second-build-path revival; slow commands in lanes; shared WD stash/reset chaos; PID kill without identity.
Leading oya-*/cloud-*/opaque/ADR-in-job-title durable names (Amendment B Pattern-First).
Silent success on blocked inputs; rubber-stamp thread resolve; merge ego after green; observation-density scoreboards.

overrules.note: Distill corpus is operating-pattern evidence, not naming authority. Brand/ADR-in-title bans stand. Legacy protection pin is dual-emit cutover only.
